info.title: SDK demo API
info.description:
The **development** API of **SDK demo**, generated by Pawabase.

Send your project key in the `apikey` header or use `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for signed-in sessions. Both authentication methods are fully supported. Every request also requires `?project_id=<ref>&environment=<env>` query parameters, so the gateway can scope key resolution to this project/environment.

`AuthenticationFailed`, and every ``HTTPException(status_code, detail="...")``
raised in the compiler).
